question_text: A 32-year-old homeless woman is brought to the emergency department by ambulance 30 minutes after the police found her on the sidewalk. On arrival, she is unresponsive. Her pulse is 76/min, respirations are 6/min, and blood pressure is 110/78 mm Hg. Examination shows cool, dry skin. The pupils are pinpoint and react sluggishly to light. Intravenous administration of a drug is initiated. Two minutes after treatment is started, the patient regains consciousness and her respirations increase to 12/min. The drug that was administered has the strongest effect on which of the following receptors?
